body_html:
Great exploration of the readings. Good model for #edu407 Nice job starting to use the affordances of digital writing by including images. Make sure to remember our friends who use screen readers.

When using images with lot's of text you can fit that in the alt="" tag (there is a text box for this in WordPress) you should explain the same information in your text our a caption.

caption: Common Core State Standards, which include English Language Arts and the History/Social Studies, Science and Technical Subject span grades k12 in the areas of reading, writing, speaking and listening, and language.

You could include this information in your text as well. This way people who use screen readers can see it as well.
